title: Dispatch #1
body:
Classified

TO: All agents
RE: Week one

The first week is in the books. Eleven agents have fallen. Twenty-six remain. The Graveyard is up to date. There were a few near misses around ORGT, so some of you were lucky this week.

Running shoes are essential. As I hinted. Some of you got seriously creative with your intel gathering. I am impressed, and excited to see what comes next. The list is shorter now, and everyone left is watching.

Fine print: the safe zones got a few clarifications this week. The lecture hall, wall practice and the pool at Roll School each have their own rules, so be familiar with them on the rules page before you assume you are protected, or exposed.

If you are eliminated, forward your target to your killer. If you cannot, email or text me and I will sort it out.

The next dispatch lands next Friday at 9 pm. Happy hunting.

Headquarters

title: Welcome, Agent
body:
The case is open. Welcome to ORGT Assassin. On Nov 1 at 12:00 am the hunt begins, and every agent in the game will have a target.

Get ready:

  • Sign up by Oct 27 at 11:59 pm. Miss the deadline and you are sitting this one out.
  • Grab your weapon at ORGT from Oct 27 to Oct 30 during open Outpost hours. Only grab one.
  • Watch your inbox. Your target arrives by email before the game starts.
  • Learn the rules, especially the safe zones. Know where you are protected and where you are not.
  • Join the GroupMe. Announcements, surprises and safe objects for certain weeks are shared there and on this site.

Dispatches will land here every Friday at 9 pm with the latest from the field. Until then, trust no one, check behind you, and keep your eyes open.
